description: This file defines the SaveModuleConfigurationController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends a base Vue controller class and sets up a Vue component for editing module configurations during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: SaveModuleConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller handling the save operation for module configurations, extends AbstractVueController to utilize Vue.js components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by creating a 'module-configuration-edit' component instance and assigning it to the controller.
